7aeb245863: Teacher: Leo Lee, Pixel Studio｜Source material: Pixel Studio's jazz piano class schedule (beginner), intro to pop piano materials, piano basics and chord notes, and broken-chord accompaniment notes, reorganised and revised in 2026.
a371ebc106: Lots of people learned piano as children, mostly classical at their parents' request, and later let it go. This course starts from basic theory and an overview of chords, combines them with playing technique to reach the goal of playing and singing, then goes on to strengthen relative pitch and build the skills to accompany freely and arrange simply. Whatever music you usually listen to, you'll be able to play a piece that's your own.
7dccf0c1f7: The course has twelve lessons of 120 minutes each, 24 hours in all. The first eight lay the groundwork in reading, fingering, chords and accompaniment, with a play-and-sing mid-course performance in Lesson 8; the last four go deeper into scale degrees, progressions and rhythm styles, with the final performance in Lesson 12.

9a77d313ad: Jazz piano uses dissonant seventh chords, improvises freely on the melody and accompanies with walking bass. Triads are the foundation of seventh chords, so pop piano can be seen as the foundation of jazz piano.
